description:
Get parsed 13F-HR institutional holdings for a filer.

Returns individual stock positions with issuer name, CUSIP, FIGI, market value,
share count, investment discretion, and voting authority, parsed from the 13F
information table XML ("format": "xml"), as filed: one row per entry, values in the
filer's unit (thousands of dollars for most filings before 2023, dollars since).

13F-HRs filed before SEC introduced the XML table (2013 Q2) carry their holdings as a
plain-text table in the filing's own document. For those the result has "format": "text"
and "text": that document as filed, paged by line (limit/offset count lines, total_lines
says how many). Read the table from it; search_document on its filename finds one position.
A "period_note" says when the filer's latest 13F before the period asked for is over a year
older (it stopped filing).

Each holding also carries issuer_cik, sic and sic_description (the SEC's SIC industry
classification of the issuer, not GICS) when the CUSIP maps to a company with a SIC. In a typical
quarter that is about 87% of the value held; funds, ETFs, options and unmapped CUSIPs have none.
"with_sic" in the result says how many holdings on this page were classified, so say how much of a
portfolio an industry breakdown covers. Use sic_url from get_company to see peers in an industry.

Args:
    cik: CIK of the 13F filer / institutional investor (e.g. "1535950")
    period: Get holdings as of this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the most recent 13F filed on or before this date.
    limit: Max holdings per page (1-5000, default 500)
    offset: Pagination offset
name: get_holdings
title: Get 13F Holdings
